items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: We had Roy Eldridge and Buck Clayton... myself on saxophones and I believe that was the band.

ctx.x: Forgive me, when I say the first one. I don't mean that I am looking for any credit. I just mean that it's interesting because then Lester Young was later to leave Basie and he went into the solo field. Hawkins came back, he went into the solo field. Webster left Ellington, he went into the solo field. Roy Eldridge left Krupa, he went into the solo field. All this started and we had a thing called -- we called it tenor parade.
There were about half a dozen tenor players and they all went up to play George Wein's place called Storyville in Boston. So we had the same rhythm section, we traveled alone.
